title: EXCLUSIVE: Ode Parfums Aims to Disrupt the Fragrance Market
summary: The brand's cofounders Grégory Mager and Julien Saada, who formerly cofounded Maesa, developed Ode to be an affordable luxury brand for everybody.

extraction.key_fact: Maesa를 함께 세운 창업자들이 누구나 쓸 수 있는 어포더블 럭셔리 향수 브랜드 Ode를 만들었다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The brand's cofounders Grégory Mager and Julien Saada, who formerly cofounded Maesa, developed Ode to be an affordable luxury brand for everybody.
